facts.fact: Yelp's article on ad performance says it covers four advertising data points for evaluating Yelp Ads performance.
facts.quote: we’ll take a look at four advertising data points that will help you understand how to evaluate your performance on Yelp

facts.fact: Yelp's support center is staffed Monday through Friday from 5am to 6pm PST.
Yelp's support center is staffed Saturday and Sunday from 7am to 4pm PST.
Yelp lists (877) 767-9357 as the phone number for advertiser help, available when agents are online.
facts.quote: Call us at (877) 767-9357 when our agents are available.
